title: coordination/notice/v1
description: An Annex V notice in the ANSP's inbox and its state (2021/664 Art. 13(2), Annex V; spec 02 F13), in the common envelope (04 §2): on the internal subject coord.v1.<kind>.<ack_id> and as a frame of GET /v1/coordination/stream, one per change (received, each escalation, the acknowledgement). Owned by uspace-ansp, the producer (decision record M14). It is not coordination/annex_v/v1, the USSP's request body, which it carries as payload: the body of a frame is the message its schema names (envelope/v1), and the inbox item is not a request body (docs/PLAN.md section 15 row 24). state is received (the receipt, ack_id), escalated (a nonconformance or contingent notice no person acknowledged within notice_escalation_s, repeated every 30 s until acknowledged) or acknowledged (by a person; acknowledged_by is the role, never a name). The members of the body mirror the CoordinationNotice component of api/openapi.yaml; a test holds them equal.
